title: 3DoF Animation
text: Create 3-D MATLAB Graphics animation of three-degrees-of-freedom object, 3 inputs, {Enter view} sets Entrance view Fixed; {Axes limits [xmin xmax ymin ymax zmin zmax]} sets the axes limits, {Time interval between updates}, {Size of craft displayed} scales factor, {Position of camera [xc yc zc]} sets the camera position, {View angle} and {Enable animation} displays animation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: x t z t
ports.summary: Target downrange position and altitude (positive down) two-element vector

ports.name: x e z e
ports.summary: Craft downrange position and altitude (positive down) two-element vector
